forms.label: Food-grade sodium hydroxide
forms.sourceNote: Sodium hydroxide is a chemical, not a food, and USDA publishes no record for it. This form cites the NOAA CAMEO datasheet, CAS 1310-73-2, for its identity and handling. Its figures follow from its formula, NaOH: it supplies no food energy, macronutrient, vitamin or mineral other than sodium, and sodium is 57.5 per cent of its mass, so the sodium figure is computed from the formula rather than measured. The bath is poured away after dipping, so the bath line carries a consumed share that is an editorial estimate, not a measurement. The NIOSH Pocket Guide entry for sodium hydroxide (0565) agrees that skin and eye contact should be prevented and that the substance is incompatible with aluminum and zinc.
